changeinfo.changes: - New ghost format. New ghosts can now be watched like replays - Weekly challenges and special events : add an option to watch attached replays - Fix input binding issue with some Fanatec steering wheels - Fix checkpoints. If a checkpoint is missed, player is respawned to last validated checkpoint - Network stability fixes

- Fix pad vibrations - Fix Thrustmaster steering wheel FFB - Add Fanatec and Logitech steering wheel support - Add option to configure steering wheel rotation angle - Add D-pad control for steering - Fix some menu actions missing binding on steering wheels - Change penalty system : time penalties are decreased but now stack - Display speedometer in cockpit view with close camera distance - Increase clear weather probability - Increase ghost limit per scoreboard from 5 to 10 - Improve engine sounds - Remove codriver shock voices - Remove respawn range option - Fix respawn distances - Fix trophies being unlocked after giving up a stage - Fix gear ratio setting being inverted in car configuration menu - Stability fixes
